product_metadata.title: Nordic Ware Naturals Loaf Pan, with Lifting Trivet
features: Commercial quality bake ware, loaf pan doubles as a bread baking pan too
Made of pure aluminum to produce evenly browned goods. Rims are reinforced with galvanized steel.
Perforated aluminum trivet allows excess fat to drip away while baking

Dishwasher use is not advised, as discoloration will occur due to the cleaning agents used in automatic dishwasher detergent. This discoloration is merely cosmetic and will not affect baking properties or safety of the pan.
description: Professional chefs and bakeries bake with aluminum for perfect results. You can too, with our commercial quality naturals bake ware collection. Made of pure aluminum, these premium pans produce evenly browned baked goods every time. Rims are reinforced with galvanized steel to prevent warping and aluminum will never rust. Making meat loaf has never been healthier or easier! Perforated aluminum trivet allows fat to drip away as meat bakes. Handles on trivet make it easy to lift contents for serving without sticking. Loaf pan doubles as a bread baking pan too.
